what_it_shows: Intelligence from government and sector sharing organizations and the MSSP: ransomware reaching manufacturing plant floors, compromise of suppliers and software updates, theft of designs by state-sponsored groups, edge device exploitation, payment diversion by email and voice impersonation; records of indicators shared with utilities and government partners

title: Physical security reports: badge access, access list reviews, visitor logs, CCTV and alarms
source_system: Physical security systems (SYS-15)
owner: Vice President, Corporate Facilities and Security
what_it_shows: Badge-controlled offices and plant server rooms, locked OT DMZ cabinets, and quarterly access list reviews; visitor management with escort at all sites; about 1,600 CCTV cameras, with server room alarms monitored by the security desk; colocation cage access lists; spare yards with fencing, gates and patrols, CCTV at 2 of the 3 yards and no intrusion detection at the Tennessee yard

title: IT asset disposition records and certificates of destruction
source_system: IT asset management; disposal vendor portal
what_it_shows: Certificates of destruction from a certified vendor for disposed drives and kiosks; sanitization records for reused equipment; shredding vendor certificates; deletion certificates for subscriber and member data at contract end

title: Facility resilience records
source_system: Facilities document library; work order system
owner: Vice President, Corporate Facilities and Security
what_it_shows: Generators for server rooms, oven safety systems and test laboratory controls; fire suppression in server rooms; hurricane procedures; DC-1 in Florida and DC-2 in Texas, with the engineering compute cluster in DC-1 only

title: FY2025 revenue report by segment
source_system: ERP financial reporting (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: Annual revenue of about $4.8 billion, about $13.2 million per calendar day: distribution and specialty transformers 46%, power transformers 41%, field service and repair 8%, Spare Transformer Reserve Service 3%, Fleet Monitoring Service 2%; exports about 9%

title: Shipments by plant and production day, FY2025
source_system: ERP shipping and sales reporting (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: About 250 production days; shipments per production day of about $4.6 million at P1, $3.9 million at P2, $3.4 million at P3, $2.0 million at P4, $2.0 million at P5 and $0.8 million at P7, about $16.7 million in total; P6 ships components to the other plants, which hold about 5 production days of P6 parts; field service and repair about $1.5 million, STRS about $0.4 million and FMS about $0.26 million per calendar day

title: Operational volume report, January to April 2026
source_system: ERP, MES, EDI, FMS and STRS reporting
what_it_shows: About 310,000 distribution transformers and 1,350 power transformers a year; about 650 utility customers; large power transformer backlog about 30 months and distribution backlog about 26 weeks; about 46,000 work orders released a month; about 3,400 EDI documents a day; storm-restoration production slots reserved each hurricane season

title: Site and legal entity register
source_system: Corporate legal entity management; real estate records
what_it_shows: 7 plants in Florida, Georgia, Tennessee, Texas, North Carolina and Ohio (P7 is AQ-01, acquired 2025-07-01), 9 service and repair centers, 3 spare transformer yards (Florida, Tennessee, Texas) and 2 colocation data centers (DC-1 Florida, DC-2 Texas); no sites in California, Colorado, Illinois or New York City

title: Integration Management Office status report and AQ-01 due diligence findings
source_system: Integration Management Office tracker
what_it_shows: AQ-01 (about 650 employees) runs a legacy ERP and MES on servers in the plant server room, backed up nightly, with no restore test record; legacy directory with a two-way trust; flat OT network; 5 always-on OEM cellular routers with shared logins (2 drying ovens, 2 cast-coil molding lines, 1 vacuum pressure impregnation system); no OT monitoring and no SIEM logging; one SD-WAN carrier; AQ-01 payroll moved to the enterprise provider in 2025-10 and its ledger is consolidated monthly by journal upload; integration plan: identity federation by 2026-12-31, OT DMZ and gateway by 2027-03-31, ERP and MES migration by 2027-06-30; the deal budget did not include OT integration

title: Productivity suite security settings
source_system: Productivity suite admin console (SYS-13)
what_it_shows: Sensitivity labels and sharing limits, with FCI in labeled, restricted project sites; DLP policies on email and web with monthly alert reports; audit logs forwarded to the SIEM; unapproved public generative AI tools blocked at the web gateway since 2025; personal devices limited to managed apps

title: Data classification register and data inventory
source_system: GRC platform data inventory
what_it_shows: Restricted data types (designs, customer drawings, firmware source and keys, FCI, certification test data) with owners and systems; customer data segregated by tenant in the FMS and STRS; AQ-01 certification test data and HR extracts on file shares are not in the inventory

title: PLM, TDMS and enterprise data platform access and configuration reports
source_system: PLM; TDMS (SYS-07); enterprise data platform (Cloud provider B)
what_it_shows: PLM access granted by project; customer drawings exchanged with about 650 customers by email; TDMS audit trail, with test technicians able to edit records before Quality sign-off and integrity monitoring on stored test files; the data platform reads plant data only from the read-only historian replica in each OT DMZ and grants access by approved use case; USB storage blocked on engineering endpoints

title: HR, payroll and applicant tracking configuration
source_system: HR, payroll and applicant tracking SaaS (SYS-13)
what_it_shows: Payroll changes need two people; weekly production payroll; HR exports kept on file shares; the applicant tracking system shows an applicant screening and ranking feature switched on in a 2026 vendor release

title: AI governance committee register, intake forms and minutes
source_system: AI governance committee site (GRC platform)
what_it_shows: Committee formed in 2025 under POL-01; 9 use cases with completed committee review (AI-001, AI-002, AI-003, AI-004, AI-005, AI-007, AI-008, AI-009 and AI-013, the last reviewed 2026-05-20); AI-002 is a pilot since 2026-02; about 6,000 licensed users of the enterprise generative AI assistant (AI-008)

title: SaaS and AI feature review
source_system: Vendor release notes; SSO application catalog; ERP, applicant tracking and security tooling feature settings; procurement records
what_it_shows: AI features switched on inside existing products with no committee review record: applicant screening and ranking in the applicant tracking SaaS (AI-006), RFQ specification extraction in the ERP configure-price-quote module enabled in a 2026-05 release (AI-010), accounts payable invoice capture and matching (AI-011), SOC alert triage in the security tooling (AI-012) and the APS scheduling optimizer piloted at P3 (AI-014); with the committee register this gives 14 use cases

title: BIA interviews: plant, production and quality owners
source_system: Interviews (plant managers P1 to P7; Vice President, Manufacturing Operations; Vice President, Operations Planning; Corporate Director of Quality; Chief Supply Chain Officer)
what_it_shows: Each owner's description of their process, the systems, third parties and people it uses, its manual workaround, and the longest outage and data loss they say it can tolerate; plant managers cite drying cycle restarts, paper travelers for about one shift, and storm-restoration demand

title: BIA interviews: corporate, service line, product and compliance owners
source_system: Interviews (Vice President, Sales Operations; Chief Technology Officer; Vice President, Spares and Services; Vice President, Digital Services; Chief Human Resources Officer; Chief Accounting Officer; Chief Compliance Officer)
what_it_shows: Each owner's description of their process, dependencies, workaround and tolerable outage and data loss; service line owners cite the subscription and member agreement commitments; the Chief Compliance Officer cites the shortest notice clocks; the Chief Accounting Officer cites the quarter-end filing window

title: BIA dependency and contract review
source_system: Vendor contracts; DR and drill records; contract RTO schedules
what_it_shows: Contract RTOs, alternates and last test dates for 26 dependencies; 14 rely on a single provider, facility or instance (one only at AQ-01); the AQ-01 legacy ERP and MES restore has no test on record; last recorded tests include the SD-WAN failover 2026-03-14, colocation 2026-02-21, EDI failover drill 2025-10-04, HR and payroll SaaS 2025-12-06, MSSP 2026-06-12, plant generators 2026-06-06 and the manual restricted-party screening fallback 2026-06-18

title: Risk analysis workshops
source_system: Workshops (SOC; OT Security; plant controls engineering; Integration Management Office; Product Security; Supply Chain; Digital Services; Spares and Services; Finance; Human Resources; Maintenance)
what_it_shows: Owners' accounts of past incidents, near misses and threat scenarios in their areas, and the controls they rely on; the Maintenance Director described a 2026-07 proposal from the P4 maintenance team to extend vacuum pump and heater maintenance on two drying ovens from 4 to 8 weeks, citing AI-002 health scores

title: Gap analysis interviews with control owners
source_system: Interviews (CISO; Chief Compliance Officer; Director of OT Security; Director of Federal Programs; Director of Security Operations; Director of Identity and Access Management; Director of Third-Party Risk Management; Director of Product Security; General Counsel; Corporate Director of Quality; Director of Trade Compliance)
what_it_shows: Owners' descriptions of how each CSF 2.0 outcome and binding requirement is carried out today and where the records are kept; field technicians are not trained on utility access rules; FMS analytics model updates have no formal change record; boot firmware loaded by the contract manufacturer is not verified at final test

title: Plant walk-throughs, P1 to P7
source_system: Plants P1 to P7 (observation)
what_it_shows: OT DMZs, boundary firewalls, isolation points, kiosk areas and downtime kits observed at P1 to P6; at AQ-01 (2026-06-23 and 2026-06-24) the flat OT network, the dual-homed MES server and the 5 OEM cellular routers were observed, and no isolation points are documented

title: External TLS scan of internet-facing services and EPSP interfaces
source_system: Scanner run by Security Operations for the GRC team
what_it_shows: Internet-facing services, the supplier portal and the ERP, EDI and MES interfaces accept TLS 1.2 or higher only

title: Gap analysis samples: obligations register, utility notices, disclosures and releases
source_system: Obligations register; utility addenda; notice log; PSIRT disclosure log; release records
what_it_shows: 30 of 88 addenda traced to the register: 4 entries record 48 hours where the addendum says 24; all 41 access-revocation notices in 2026 checked: 3 sent after 1 business day; all 9 vulnerability disclosures to addendum utilities in 2026 checked: 1 sent on day 38; all 34 TMU firmware and software releases in 2026 had published hashes; no incident notice to a utility was required in 2026

title: Gap analysis samples: supplier contracts, Tier 2 reviews, subcontracts and vendor notice terms
source_system: Contract management system; vendor register
what_it_shows: 40 of 410 contracts with suppliers that have access or data: 6 without security terms; all 46 Tier 1 reviews current; 40 of 312 Tier 2 suppliers: 15 reviews overdue; all 14 subcontracts with FCI: 2 (heavy-haul and site installation) without the FAR 52.204-21 flow-down; all 38 vendors holding employee personal information: 4 AQ-01 contracts without a notice term

title: Gap analysis samples: training, incidents, exceptions, field laptops, disposal and federal project sites
source_system: Learning system; SOC case management; exception register; field laptops; disposal certificates; federal project sites
what_it_shows: 60 of 12,000 training records complete; 25 of 248 security incidents (2026-01 to 2026-06) triaged and classified as recorded; 25 of 31 exceptions open in 2026 had ratings, approvals and expiry dates; 25 of about 420 field laptops held no saved utility credentials; 25 of 1,880 disposed devices had certificates; access to all 11 federal project sites matched the approved lists; no exceptions in these samples

title: Gap analysis analytics: OT life cycle, ICS advisories and supplier portal MFA
source_system: OT asset inventory; ICS advisory tracker; supplier portal account export
what_it_shows: All about 620 HMIs and engineering workstations checked: 148 on unsupported operating systems, 96 of them with no documented compensating controls; 60 of 214 applicable ICS advisories (2026-01 to 2026-06): 19 not triaged within 30 days; all 420 supplier portal accounts: 38 without MFA

title: Gap analysis samples: DOE certification and export records
source_system: TDMS; DOE certification files; ERP export screening logs and records
what_it_shows: 25 of 112 certified basic models had certification reports and test data: all 25 complete, and 3 (all AQ-01) not indexed for DOE review; 25 of 1,060 export shipments (2021 to 2026) had records retained; 25 of 212 export orders (2026-01 to 2026-06) were screened before release

title: Federal clause checks: FASCSA SAM.gov search and covered equipment inventory review
source_system: SAM.gov search record; FASCSA review log; camera and network equipment inventory
what_it_shows: SAM.gov FASCSA search on 2026-07-21 found no applicable orders; of the 4 quarterly reviews due since 2025-11, the 2026-05 review has no record; camera and network equipment inventories for all 7 plants, 9 service centers and 3 yards showed no covered telecommunications equipment

title: Control assessment: Account management samples
source_system: Identity governance workflows; ERP and MES user exports; HR termination records; ERP Platform Manager interview; 60 of 1,436 account events and 60 of 1,960 terminations (50 enterprise, 10 AQ-01)
what_it_shows: All 60 sampled account events matched approved requests and role templates; all 50 sampled enterprise terminations were disabled the same day; 2 of the 10 sampled AQ-01 terminations were disabled 4 and 7 days late in the legacy directory, which is not connected to identity governance; supplier portal accounts are not reviewed periodically, and 63 were inactive over 90 days

title: Control assessment: Inactive account analytic
source_system: Inactivity job configuration; account exports (6,020 accounts: 5,600 ERP workforce and 420 supplier portal)
what_it_shows: Workforce accounts inactive 60 days were disabled as configured; 63 supplier portal accounts inactive over 90 days were still enabled

title: Control assessment: Access enforcement test
source_system: ERP role matrix; 25 ERP users; export release attempt without the Trade Compliance role
what_it_shows: Access of all 25 sampled users matched their role templates; the export release attempt without the Trade Compliance role was blocked

title: Control assessment: Separation of duties analytic
source_system: SoD rule set; conflict report over 5,600 ERP users; Vice President, Enterprise Applications interview
what_it_shows: Conflicting duties are identified in the SoD rule set; 23 users hold conflicting roles (routing maintenance with schedule release, or vendor maintenance with payment) with no mitigating review recorded

title: Control assessment: Privileged session sample
source_system: PAM records; role assignments; 25 of 2,180 elevation sessions to ERP, database and MES servers
what_it_shows: All 25 sampled elevations were approved, time-limited and recorded

title: Control assessment: Remote access review and engineering workstation scan
source_system: Remote access standard; gateway configuration; 3 remote access paths; scan of 48 engineering workstations in MES zones
collected_by: Internal Audit (IT audit team, with the co-sourced OT specialist)
what_it_shows: Usage restrictions and connection requirements are documented for the zero-trust service, the OT gateway and ERP vendor support; the scan found an OEM remote tool installed on a P4 engineering workstation in the MES zone, a remote path outside the gateway (reported to the CISO 2026-08-22)

title: Control assessment: Training records and phishing results
source_system: Learning system; phishing simulation reports; 60 of 12,000 training records; 6 months of phishing results
what_it_shows: All 60 sampled workforce completed training; monthly phishing simulations ran for the 6 months examined, with a June 2026 click rate of 4.1%

title: Control assessment: Role-based training sample
source_system: Role training records; curriculum; 40 of 412 staff in EPSP and OT security roles
what_it_shows: 9 of 40 sampled controls technicians and MES administrators received access before role training; 7 of the 40 had not completed the annual refresher; role-based content is current and was updated after incidents

title: Control assessment: Event logging test
source_system: Logging standard; ERP audit configuration; 6 event types generated in test
what_it_shows: The 6 event types generated in test were recorded as defined

title: Control assessment: Audit review records and log source check
source_system: SOC review records (5 of 26 weeks); SIEM source list (63 tier-1 log sources)
what_it_shows: SOC review records exist for the 5 sampled weeks, findings were reported and the review level was adjusted after the AQ-01 acquisition; 7 of the 63 tier-1 log sources (the MES application logs at P3 and P4 and the AQ-01 systems) send no logs to the SIEM, so they are not reviewed

title: Control assessment: Log archive protection test
source_system: Log archive policies; deletion attempt
what_it_shows: Write-once settings in place; the deletion attempt was blocked

title: Control assessment: Retention settings inspection
source_system: Retention settings
what_it_shows: Audit records kept 1 year online and 7 years in the archive

title: Control assessment: Audit generation check
source_system: Audit configuration on 6 ERP servers, 2 integration nodes and 4 MES servers
what_it_shows: Audit generation enabled on all sampled components

title: Control assessment: Continuous monitoring review
source_system: Monitoring dashboard; KRI reports; 3 of 6 monthly metric packages; GRC interview
what_it_shows: Metrics produced and reviewed for the 3 sampled months

title: Control assessment: Baseline comparison
source_system: Baselines; drift reports; 12 EPSP servers
what_it_shows: All 12 servers matched their baselines

title: Control assessment: EPSP change sample
source_system: Change tickets; CAB minutes; ERP change documents; 40 of 212 changes (2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30)
what_it_shows: Change types are defined, the CAB convened weekly and records were retained; 5 of 40 sampled master data and APS scheduling rule changes had no independent approval and no documented decision

title: Control assessment: Change access trace
source_system: PAM records; transport logs; 10 changes traced to PAM sessions
what_it_shows: All 10 sampled production changes were made through PAM by authorized release staff

title: Control assessment: Configuration compliance scans
source_system: Configuration compliance reports; 12 servers; 60 kiosks at P3 and P4
what_it_shows: Settings are documented and monitored; 37 P3 kiosks on an unsupported operating system deviate from the kiosk baseline with no approved deviation record

title: Control assessment: Inventory trace
source_system: CMDB; floor walk at P3 and P4; 60 kiosks and scanners
what_it_shows: 9 of 60 sampled kiosks and scanners were not in the CMDB or were recorded at the wrong location; granularity and review cycle are defined

title: Control assessment: Contingency plan review
source_system: EPSP contingency plan v5; 4 interviews
what_it_shows: Plan covers objectives, roles, priorities and restoration; it does not describe how plants keep scheduling during an outage (manual APS fallback) or the STRS registry dependency

title: Control assessment: Contingency test review
source_system: DR test report; MES restore records for 6 MES instances
what_it_shows: DR test results were reviewed and corrective actions opened; MES restores were tested at 2 of 6 plants (P1, P5) in the last 12 months

title: Control assessment: Backup sample and restore observation
source_system: Backup reports; 25 of 181 daily ERP backup jobs; 6 MES backup sets; 1 restore observed
what_it_shows: All 25 sampled ERP backup jobs were complete, encrypted and immutable, and the observed restore succeeded; of the 6 MES backup sets, the P3 job excluded the configuration database

title: Control assessment: DR test timeline review
source_system: DR test report 2026-05-16; interviews
what_it_shows: Reconstitution to a known state was demonstrated; recovery took 11 hours against the 8-hour RTO

title: Control assessment: Sign-in sample
source_system: SSO logs; 25 ERP sign-ins
what_it_shows: All 25 sampled sign-ins used unique identities

title: Control assessment: Privileged MFA check
source_system: Conditional access policy; FIDO2 registrations; 64 privileged EPSP accounts
what_it_shows: All 64 privileged accounts require FIDO2 MFA

title: Control assessment: Authenticator and OEM default credential tests (P2 2026-08-08, AQ-01 2026-08-15, P4 2026-08-22)
source_system: PAM vault; credential tests on about 90 OT devices with web interfaces at P2, P4 and AQ-01, with OEM approval in maintenance windows
collected_by: Internal Audit (IT audit team, with the co-sourced OT specialist)
what_it_shows: Authenticator management procedures are in place; OEM default passwords were accepted on the web configuration interface of 5 drying oven HMIs: 2 at AQ-01 (reported to the CISO 2026-08-15) and 3 at P4 (reported 2026-08-22)

title: Control assessment: Supplier portal MFA analytic
source_system: Portal MFA report; 420 supplier portal accounts
what_it_shows: MFA not enforced for 38 supplier accounts (9%)

title: Control assessment: Incident handling sample
source_system: Case records; 25 of 248 incidents and all 11 AQ-01 incidents
what_it_shows: All sampled incidents were handled under the playbooks

title: Control assessment: Incident reporting and notice review
source_system: Notice log; obligations register; 41 access-revocation notices; 25 incidents; 20 staff interviews
what_it_shows: Staff know to report within 1 hour; 3 of 41 access-revocation notices were sent after 1 business day; the runbook uses a single 48-hour clock although 27 addenda require 24 hours

title: Control assessment: Incident response plan and materiality procedure review
source_system: IR plan; materiality procedure; committee minutes; interviews with the General Counsel, CFO, CISO and COO
what_it_shows: Plan structure, roles and distribution examined; the materiality procedure has no method for production loss, deferred revenue and liquidated damages and no OT scenario; the plan was not updated after the AQ-01 acquisition or the 2026 committee changes

title: Control assessment: Nonlocal maintenance review
source_system: Gateway logs; 25 gateway sessions to MES zones; engineering workstation scan
collected_by: Internal Audit (IT audit team, with the co-sourced OT specialist)
what_it_shows: All 25 sampled gateway sessions were approved, MFA-protected, recorded and closed; sessions through the P4 OEM tool had no approval and no records, and the tool is not allowed by policy

title: Control assessment: Termination sample
source_system: HR records; identity governance; 60 of 1,960 terminations (same sample as AC-2)
what_it_shows: Enterprise terminations were disabled the same day, credentials revoked and property retrieved; 2 of the 10 sampled AQ-01 terminations were disabled 4 and 7 days late

title: Control assessment: Risk assessment review
source_system: 2026 risk analysis (P01)
what_it_shows: The 2026 risk analysis records its scope, method, results, review and distribution

title: Control assessment: Vulnerability and ICS advisory sample
source_system: Advisory log; scan reports; 60 of 214 applicable ICS advisories; 60 of 3,880 IT findings on EPSP components
what_it_shows: Scanning frequency and tools in place; 19 of 60 sampled applicable ICS advisories were not analyzed within 30 days, and remediation for them was not scheduled

title: Control assessment: External service review
source_system: Vendor register; SOC report reviews; 12 external services supporting the EPSP
what_it_shows: Security requirements are in the contracts; 2 of 12 services lacked a current assurance review (the EDI provider's report expired 2026-03; the APS add-on vendor was never reviewed)

title: Control assessment: Unsupported component review
source_system: Unsupported component list
what_it_shows: Extended support options are documented; 37 P3 MES kiosks on an unsupported operating system have not been replaced

title: Control assessment: Boundary review and reachability test
source_system: Firewall exports; reachability test from the AQ-01 office network
collected_by: Internal Audit (IT audit team, with the co-sourced OT specialist)
what_it_shows: External interfaces are monitored and controlled; from the AQ-01 office network the test reached the AQ-01 PLC network through the dual-homed MES and the corporate domain controllers through the two-way trust

title: Control assessment: Transmission protection test
source_system: TLS scan of all EPSP interfaces
what_it_shows: All interfaces use TLS 1.2 or later

title: Control assessment: Encryption at rest inspection
source_system: Database and backup encryption settings
what_it_shows: Customer-managed keys encrypt the ERP database and backups

title: Control assessment: Patch sample
source_system: Patch reports; 60 of 1,240 critical patches
what_it_shows: Flaws are identified, tested and tracked; 3 of 60 sampled critical patches were installed after the 30-day standard

title: Control assessment: Malicious code protection check
source_system: EDR console; allowlisting reports; 12 servers and 25 kiosks
what_it_shows: Protection active and updating on all sampled servers and kiosks

title: Control assessment: Monitoring tests (P2 2026-08-08, AQ-01 2026-08-15, P4 2026-08-22)
source_system: Sensor alerts; SOC tickets; rogue device tests at P4 and AQ-01; after-hours alert test at P2
collected_by: Internal Audit (IT audit team, with the co-sourced OT specialist)
what_it_shows: Detected events are analyzed and monitoring is adjusted for risk; the after-hours OT alert at P2 reached the OT team the next morning, 14 hours later; AQ-01 has no monitoring and the rogue device test there was not detected

title: Control assessment: Integrity monitoring review
source_system: Integrity monitoring reports
what_it_shows: Integrity checks run and alerts are reviewed

title: Control assessment: Supplier assessment review
source_system: Vendor register; all 46 Tier 1 and 40 of 312 Tier 2 suppliers
what_it_shows: All 46 Tier 1 reviews current; 15 of 40 sampled Tier 2 reviews overdue; the TMU contract manufacturer has never been assessed
